added_claim_errors: ‘소액체당금’ is an outdated name for 간이대지급금 (general knowledge); the current scheme should be identified.
‘7~9월 석 달이면 이 요건을 넘고’ incorrectly treats three late-payment months as sufficient without establishing qualifying delay days or unpaid amounts.
‘2년 근무면 150일분’ ignores the 180-day entitlement for people aged 50 or older or with disabilities.
‘하루 6만6,048~6만8,100원’ presents the eight-hour minimum without establishing daily working hours.
‘조기재취업수당(남은 급여의 절반, 12개월 이상 근무 시)’ omits the required 14-day interval after reporting unemployment and at least half the benefit days remaining.

reasons: Both answers immediately correct the voluntary-resignation premise, but A avoids B’s central error of treating three months with late payments as automatic satisfaction of the qualifying threshold. B provides useful amounts, but assumes age and working hours and incompletely describes the reemployment allowance; its approximate monetary arithmetic otherwise checks out. Both omit the concrete delay-day test, the seven-day waiting period, and livelihood loans, and both describe the 12-month benefit window too loosely as an application deadline. A wins for better calibration, although neither is sufficiently brief or complete.
